GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek.

Reply with JSON only, in exactly this form and nothing else:

{"model": "<one of GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek>", "confidence": <1-5>, "reason": "<one short sentence>"}

--- TEXT ---
Sunlight reaching Earth's atmosphere contains all the colors of the rainbow, which travel as waves of different lengths. The gases in the air scatter this light in all directions, but they scatter shorter wavelengths, like blue, much more than longer wavelengths like red. Because this blue light is scattered everywhere across the sky, it is the primary color we see when we look up during the day.
--- END ---
Output the JSON object described above, and nothing else.
